# Hiddenwires Magazine

> > Professional coverage of AV technology, immersive audio, smart homes, and home cinema with industry insights from leading manufacturers and innovators.

Hiddenwires Magazine beta site covers product launches, industry news, technical analysis, and case studies focused on audio-visual integration, home theatre, and smart home technology. The publication features contributions from industry experts and covers major technologies including Dolby Atmos, Dante networking, and emerging audio formats.

## Key Topics

- Dolby Atmos
- Immersive audio
- Home cinema
- Surround sound
- Dante networking
- AES67
- DSP
- Product launches
- Audio engineering
- Smart home technology
- Custom installation
- Audio codecs
- Speaker placement
- Accessibility features
- AV integration

- [ADI expands Triad portfolio with 120 new amplifiers, speakers and subwoofers](https://beta.hiddenwires.co.uk/products/article/adi-expands-triad-portfolio-with-120-new-amplifiers-speakers-and-subwoofers): ADI Global Distribution Triad portfolio expansion with 120 audio components
